name: How long does basement drywall finishing usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does basement drywall finishing usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: For a typical unfinished 1,000-square-foot basement, drywall framing, hanging, taping, and finishing often takes about 3 to 5 days, with an extra day or two if you want a smoother paint-ready finish. Delays are more likely if the basement has moisture problems, lots of corners, or complex layout changes.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most standard basement drywall finishing jobs take several days, not hours. A simple space may be ready in 3 to 5 days, while smoother finishes or complicated layouts can take longer.
